Why go: the comfort of a motor yacht with catamaran stability

Samui Buddy is a 16 m motor catamaran. Two hulls make it steadier than a monohull at anchor, and two 315 hp engines make it faster than a sailing catamaran between islands. It has a flybridge for the views, two cabins and three bathrooms, and a crew of five. That is a big crew for a boat this size, so service is attentive.

The 2-hour sunset cruise suits a celebration dinner or a group that only has an evening. The 4-hour half day stays near Samui for snorkelling and swimming. The full days are the best value per hour: Ang Thong from 16 December, Koh Tan, Pig Island and Koh Rap in the south, or the Koh Phangan coast. Fishing gear is on board, so you can try a line at anchor.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: families with young children or older relatives, groups who want bathrooms and shade, and parties of up to 40.
  • Choose something else if: you want to sail. The Lagoon 500 sailing catamaran is similar in size. For a cheaper sunset with a small group, see the Madam C catamaran.

Good to know

  • Food and drink: decide on lunch when you book; the crew can only cater what is ordered in advance. Corkage and catering fees apply to anything you bring.
  • Fees: bring cash for the park and island fees.
  • Flybridge: the upper deck has the best views but also the most sun. Bring hats and reef-safe sunscreen.
  • Season: February to September is calmest. The sunset cruise runs most reliably all year because it stays close to the coast.
